name: Rampart Seal
description: When adjacent to an ally, place an impassable barrier for 2 turns on an adjacent empty square.
image_description: A stone white Rook standing shoulder-to-shoulder with an allied Knight, projecting a glowing cyan forcefield wall across the open file square directly in front of them.

name: Turret Bastion
description: When diagonal to an ally, place an impassable 2-turn wall on an adjacent empty square.
image_description: A heavy Rook gliding down a marble file from beside an allied Bishop, leaving a tall, shimmering hexagonal energy barrier locked onto the tile it just left behind.

name: Crown Bulwark
description: When beside King or Queen, place an impassable 1-turn wall on an adjacent empty square.
image_description: A white Rook stationed beside the white King on the back rank, extending a golden dome of interlocking shields over itself and an adjacent defensive Pawn.

name: Twin Curtain
description: With both Rooks within 2 squares, place 2-turn walls on up to 2 empty orthogonal squares.
image_description: Two white Rooks connected by a crackling beam of golden electricity across an open rank, raising twin translucent laser walls in front of the beam to seal off the frontline.

name: Siege Mantlet
description: Behind a column of 2+ allied Pawns, grant the front Pawn a kinetic shield for 1 turn.
image_description: A towering Rook aiming a focusing dish straight up its file to project an angled energy blast-shield directly in front of an advancing allied Pawn.

name: Heavy Shove
description: Push an adjacent allied non-King piece 1 or 2 squares away along your rank or file.
image_description: A massive stone Rook advancing one tile forward with a glowing pneumatic ram, propelling an allied Knight two squares deeper into the center of the board.

name: Flank Pull
description: Slide 1–2 squares and pull a diagonally adjacent allied piece into your vacated square.
image_description: A white Rook surging forward along a file while a magnetic tether of blue light pulls a nearby allied Bishop sideways into the sheltered tile the Rook just vacated.

name: Emergency Castle
description: With King on same line and clear path, castle together even if either piece has moved.
image_description: A white King and Rook on an open file swirling around each other in a burst of golden teleportation runes, swapping sides to tuck the King safely behind the fortress wall.

name: Tower Relay
description: With both Rooks on an open line, slide both Rooks 1–2 squares together along that line.
image_description: Two white Rooks lined up in a battery on the d-file, gliding forward in synchronized lockstep along twin rails of glowing golden light.

name: Battering Column
description: Directly behind an allied Pawn on the same file, advance both pieces forward 1 square.
image_description: A white Rook pressing directly against the back of a shielded allied Pawn, marching forward together as one heavy armored column down the file.

name: Railgun Bolt
description: On an open file, destroy an enemy minor piece up to 4 squares away from range without moving.
image_description: A Rook stationed at the base of a completely clear vertical file, firing a blinding blue railgun beam from its battlements that shatters a distant black Knight in place.

name: Broadside Sweep
description: Slide along a rank to capture an enemy piece and cleave an adjacent enemy Pawn above or below.
image_description: A white Rook rocketing horizontally across an empty rank to smash through a black Bishop, sending a vertical shockwave up the file that crumbles an adjacent black Pawn.

name: Corner Ricochet
description: Slide orthogonally to an empty square and destroy an adjacent diagonal enemy Pawn.
image_description: A Rook sliding into position along a file and firing a banked laser shot off an angled prism mirror to vaporize a black Pawn on the diagonal corner tile.

name: Counter-Battery
description: Slide along an open rank or file to capture an enemy Rook, piercing through an enemy Pawn in between.
image_description: Two rival Rooks facing off down a long file as the white Rook erupts with golden thrusters, blasting straight through a black Pawn in the middle to demolish the black Rook behind it.

name: Siege Bombard
description: Slide orthogonally to deliver check, destroying an enemy Pawn adjacent to your landing square.
image_description: A white Rook slamming onto the 8th rank to deliver check to a startled black King, sending a ring of seismic cracks through the adjacent tile that shatters a guard Pawn.

name: Turret Traverse
description: While pinned diagonally to King, slide 1–2 squares along the pin ray toward the attacker.
image_description: A white Rook caught in a diagonal crimson pin-beam between its King and an enemy Bishop, grinding diagonally along the beam on rotating stone gears to crush the Bishop.

name: Trench Shift
description: When having 2 or fewer legal moves, step 1 square diagonally onto an empty square.
image_description: A boxed-in white Rook surrounded by cramped pawns rotating its stone base 45 degrees to slide one tile diagonally onto a wide-open central file.

name: Armored Crawl
description: When adjacent orthogonal squares are contested, step 1 square diagonally onto an empty tile.
image_description: Red sniper beams crossing the orthogonal lanes around a white Rook as the fortress activates side-thrusters to slip one square diagonally onto a safe dark tile.

name: Flanking Wheel
description: When threatening a defended enemy, make a Knight jump (2,1) onto an empty square.
image_description: A white Rook facing a heavily fortified black Knight down a file, firing angled jump-jets to hop in an L-shaped arc onto an open flanking file.

name: Sidestep File
description: When blocked ahead by an ally, step 1 square diagonally forward onto an empty square.
image_description: A white Rook blocked by a slow allied Pawn on its file, smoothly banking one square diagonally forward around the Pawn's shoulder onto a clear open lane.

name: Drawbridge Vault
description: From starting corner, leap forward over 1 ally to land on an empty square up to rank 4.
image_description: A corner Rook lowering a glowing golden drawbridge ramp over the head of its starting Pawn, vaulting straight over the Pawn onto the 4th rank.

name: Momentum Ram
description: If moved without capturing last turn, slide to capture and immediately recoil 1–2 squares.
image_description: A high-speed white Rook slamming into a black Knight in a burst of kinetic sparks before rebounding two squares backward along its glowing track to safety.

name: Siege Hurdle
description: When unmoved for 3 turns, jump 2 squares orthogonally (Dabbaba 2,0) over any piece.
image_description: A dormant stone Rook igniting internal furnace jets beneath its base, blasting straight up to hop over a blocking piece and slam down two tiles away.

name: Overrun Vault
description: After capturing last turn, slide along rank or file and jump over 1 piece onto the square behind.
image_description: A battle-scarred white Rook surging past the rubble of its last capture, leaping cleanly over an enemy Pawn's head to land directly in the backfield behind it.

name: Perimeter Wrap
description: If moved on the last 2 turns, slide horizontally off board edge to wrap around to opposite rim.
image_description: A speeding white Rook sliding off the left rim of the chessboard into a glowing blue dimensional portal and emerging on the right rim along the same rank.

name: Garrison Call
description: When attacked by an enemy slider, spawn a fresh Pawn adjacent to this Rook on rank 2–7.
image_description: An endangered white Rook ringing its fortress alarm bell as an armored militia Pawn materializes out of golden light on the tile right in front of its gate.

name: Citadel Drop
description: When sliding to deliver check, spawn a fresh Pawn on the square this Rook just vacated.
image_description: A white Rook rocketing down a file to aim a cannon of check at the black King while a fresh white Pawn drops from the Rook's rear hatch onto the vacated tile.

name: Watchtower Levy
description: When threatening 2 or more enemy pieces, spawn a fresh Pawn adjacent to this Rook.
image_description: A white Rook spotlighting two enemy pieces with red targeting beams from its battlements while a fresh guard Pawn steps out onto the adjacent tile.

name: Sapper Deploy
description: When threatening a Rook or Queen, resurrect a captured Pawn adjacent to this Rook.
image_description: A white Rook locked onto an enemy Queen down an open file as a fallen white Pawn reforms from glowing stone fragments beside the Rook's base.

name: Militia Garrison
description: In crossfire, resurrect a captured Pawn onto rank 2 or 3 of this Rook's file.
image_description: A white Rook trading fire in the center of the board while a beacon on its home file behind it reassembles a captured Pawn on the 2nd rank.

name: Counter Smite
description: While under enemy attack, destroy the attacking piece in-place without moving.
image_description: A white Queen surrounded by dark shadow arrows raising a glowing golden hand to fire a pinpoint laser beam down a diagonal, shattering an attacking black Bishop in place.

name: Sovereign Cleave
description: When checking the enemy King, also destroy 1 enemy Pawn adjacent to your landing square.
image_description: A radiant white Queen gliding onto a checking square before the black King while a crescent wave of golden energy sweeps sideways from her crown to vaporize an adjacent black Pawn.

name: Twin Execution
description: When threatening 2 or more enemy pieces, destroy the lower-value piece from range.
image_description: A white Queen standing at the intersection of two glowing red sightlines aimed at a black Rook and a black Knight, snapping her fingers to detonate the Knight in a pillar of light.

name: Apex Skewer
description: When threatening a defended enemy, capture it and destroy an enemy piece directly behind it.
image_description: A white Queen transforming into a spear of blinding golden light, piercing straight through a shielding black Pawn to shatter the black Rook cowering behind it.

name: Crossfire Sweep
description: In crossfire, slide to capture an enemy and destroy an enemy Pawn adjacent to your vacated square.
image_description: A white Queen caught in a fierce crossfire detonating a shockwave on her starting tile that crumbles an adjacent black Pawn as she streaks forward to capture an enemy Bishop.

name: Phase Evasion
description: When attacked, slide along rank, file, or diagonal, jumping over 1 piece onto an empty square.
image_description: An endangered white Queen turning translucent like a hologram to phase straight through an allied Pawn's chest and rematerialize safely four tiles down the file.

name: Vaulting Check
description: Slide along any line and leap over 1 allied piece to deliver check to enemy King.
image_description: A white Queen leaping in a graceful arc of golden light over the battlements of an allied Rook, touching down on an open rank to point her staff at the enemy King.

name: Strike and Fade
description: When forking 2 pieces, capture one and immediately recoil back along your line to start square.
image_description: A white Queen darting forward along a glowing diagonal to shatter a black Knight and instantly rewinding in a blur of golden afterimages back to her starting square.

name: Crown Leapfrog
description: When threatening a Rook or Queen, leap directly over it onto the empty square behind.
image_description: A white Queen vaulting high over the turrets of a startled black Rook along a glowing file to land smoothly on the empty square directly behind it.

name: Slipstream Wrap
description: In crossfire on the rim, slide off the board edge to wrap around to opposite rim on same rank.
image_description: A white Queen under heavy fire gliding off the left edge of the chessboard into a swirling violet rift and emerging seamlessly on the right edge of the same rank.

name: Column Barrier
description: On an open file, place impassable 2-turn walls on up to 2 empty squares along that file.
image_description: A white Queen standing at the head of an open marble file, raising both arms to erect two sequential neon-blue forcefield walls down the corridor.

name: Horizon Curtain
description: When alone on your rank, place an impassable 2-turn wall on any empty square along that rank.
image_description: A white Queen sweeping her staff horizontally across a completely empty rank, raising a tall crystalline barrier wall across the width of the lane.

name: Prism Barricade
description: On an open diagonal, slide onto an empty square and leave a 2-turn wall on your vacated square.
image_description: A white Queen gliding down a long unobstructed diagonal, leaving a shimmering prism wall of golden light locked onto the square behind her.

name: Mirror Aegis
description: Facing enemy Queen, gain a shield until your next turn and place a 1-turn wall in between.
image_description: A white Queen and a black Queen locked in a blinding beam-struggle down an open file, where their colliding magic solidifies into a wall in the center and wraps the white Queen in a golden shield.

name: Royal Lockdown
description: With line of sight to enemy King, place an impassable 2-turn wall adjacent to the enemy King.
image_description: A white Queen staring down a black King from across the board, conjuring a glowing golden cage-wall on the empty escape tile beside the King.

name: Tower Handmaid
description: From a corner square, spawn a fresh allied Pawn on an empty adjacent square on rank 2 or 7.
image_description: A white Queen resting in a stone corner alcove, tapping her scepter to summon a loyal white Pawn onto the adjacent 2nd-rank tile.

name: Imperial Guard
description: From a central square, spawn up to 2 fresh Pawns on empty orthogonally adjacent squares.
image_description: A white Queen hovering above a glowing central tile as twin pillars of golden light materialize two armored guard Pawns at her left and right flanks.

name: Court Conscript
description: From rank 1, spawn a fresh allied Pawn on an empty 2nd-rank square directly or diagonally ahead.
image_description: A white Queen standing on her home rank throne tile, gesturing forward as a fresh marble Pawn rises from a glowing crest on the 2nd rank in front of her.

name: Wing Vanguard
description: From the rim (a/h file), resurrect a captured Pawn onto the empty square orthogonally inward.
image_description: A white Queen perched on the outer edge of the chessboard, extending her hand inward to reform a shattered white Pawn from floating stone shards on the b-file.

name: Rearguard Levy
description: In enemy territory, slide to an empty square and spawn a fresh Pawn on your vacated square.
image_description: A white Queen surging deeper into enemy territory while a fresh white Pawn materializes out of her trailing golden cape on the tile she just left.

name: Decoy Switch
description: While pinned to King, swap positions with an unpinned ally within 2 squares into the pin line.
image_description: A white Queen trapped in a glowing red sniper beam trading places in a flash of golden light with a nearby allied Pawn, who steps into the beam with shield raised.

name: Clear the Way
description: When having 5 or fewer legal moves, push an adjacent allied piece 1–2 squares away along that line.
image_description: A boxed-in white Queen releasing a pulse of telekinetic wind that slides an adjacent allied Knight two tiles forward down an open lane.

name: Escort Screen
description: When adjacent squares are contested, pull an allied piece within 2 squares adjacent to you.
image_description: A white Queen surrounded by enemy target markers beckoning with a tether of light to pull a nearby allied Bishop onto the threatened square right in front of her.

name: Vanguard Tow
description: When threatening a defended enemy, slide to an empty tile and advance an allied Pawn 1 square.
image_description: A white Queen gliding laterally across the board while a golden slipstream pulls an allied Pawn on the neighboring file one square forward.

name: Royal Swap
description: Swap positions with any directly adjacent allied non-King piece on rank 2–7.
image_description: A white Queen and an adjacent allied Rook rotating smoothly around each other on a glowing golden turntable sigil to trade squares.

name: Royal Leap
description: From start square d1/d8, make a Knight jump (2,1) over pieces onto an empty square.
image_description: A white Queen on her starting d1 throne leaping in a graceful L-shaped arc of starlight over her frontline Pawns onto the 3rd rank.

name: Amazon Hop
description: If moved last turn, make a Knight jump (2,1) onto an empty square or to capture.
image_description: A white Queen in full stride surrounded by a glowing spectral Pegasus aura, executing an L-shaped Knight jump over an enemy wall to strike a black Bishop.

name: Camel Stride
description: When unmoved for 3 turns, make a Camel leap (3,1 vector) over pieces onto an empty square.
image_description: A still, glowing white Queen suddenly vanishing in a clap of thunder and reappearing three ranks ahead and one file over in a long, sweeping arc of light.

name: Pivot Step
description: After capturing last turn, slide 1–2 diagonal squares then step 1 square orthogonally.
image_description: A victorious white Queen skating two tiles diagonally across the board before pivoting sharply 45 degrees to step onto an adjacent open file.

name: Dogleg Leap
description: If moved on last 2 turns, slide 1–2 squares orthogonally then 1–2 squares diagonally.
image_description: A speeding white Queen tracing a sharp zig-zagging trail of golden light—two tiles straight forward and two tiles diagonally—around a central obstruction.

name: Keep Garrison
description: If your King is within 1 square of a board corner (a1, b1, g1, h1 for White; a8, b8, g8, h8 for Black), spawn a fresh allied Pawn on an empty square adjacent to your King that lies between the 2nd and 7th ranks.
card_description: If your King is within 1 square of a board corner (a1, b1, g1, h1 for White; a8, b8, g8, h8 for Black), spawn a fresh allied Pawn on an empty square adjacent to your King that lies between the 2nd and 7th ranks.
image_description: A white King tucked safely in his castled corner keep, raising his royal scepter as an armored guard Pawn materializes on the 2nd-rank tile in front of him.

name: Imperial Rally
description: If your King occupies one of the 4 central squares (d4, d5, e4, e5), spawn up to 2 fresh allied Pawns on empty squares adjacent (orthogonally or diagonally) to your King (all of which lie safely between the 3rd and 6th ranks).
card_description: If your King occupies one of the 4 central squares (d4, d5, e4, e5), spawn up to 2 fresh allied Pawns on empty squares adjacent (orthogonally or diagonally) to your King (all of which lie safely between the 3rd and 6th ranks).
image_description: A bold white King standing atop the central squares of the board, planting his banner as two fresh white Pawns rise from golden sigils on either side of him.

name: Throne Levy
description: If your King is on your 1st rank, spawn a fresh allied Pawn on an empty 2nd-rank square directly in front of or diagonally in front of your King.
card_description: If your King is on your 1st rank, spawn a fresh allied Pawn on an empty 2nd-rank square directly in front of or diagonally in front of your King.
image_description: A white King seated on the back rank tapping the marble floor with his sword, summoning a fresh white Pawn onto the 2nd-rank shield square before him.

name: Border Conscript
description: If your King is on the outer edge of the board (a-file or h-file), resurrect 1 captured allied Pawn from your graveyard onto an empty square adjacent to your King that lies between the 2nd and 7th ranks.
card_description: If your King is on the outer edge of the board (a-file or h-file), resurrect 1 captured allied Pawn from your graveyard onto an empty square adjacent to your King that lies between the 2nd and 7th ranks.
image_description: A white King marching along the outer rim of the board, extending a glowing hand to reassemble a fallen white Pawn onto the adjacent inner square.

name: Conqueror's Call
description: If your King has crossed into enemy territory (ranks 5 through 8), resurrect 1 captured allied Pawn from your graveyard onto an empty square directly behind or diagonally behind your King (all of which lie safely between the 4th and 7th ranks).
card_description: If your King has crossed into enemy territory (ranks 5 through 8), resurrect 1 captured allied Pawn from your graveyard onto an empty square directly behind or diagonally behind your King (all of which lie safely between the 4th and 7th ranks).
image_description: A crowned white King deep inside enemy territory blowing a golden horn as a fallen Pawn rises from the shadows on the tile directly behind his cape.

name: Citadel Moat
description: If your King is within 1 square of a board corner (a1, b1, g1, h1, a8, b8, g8, or h8), place impassable holographic walls for 2 turns on up to 2 empty squares adjacent to your King.
card_description: If your King is within 1 square of a board corner (a1, b1, g1, h1, a8, b8, g8, or h8), place impassable holographic walls for 2 turns on up to 2 empty squares adjacent to your King.
image_description: A white King in the corner of the board activating a royal mechanism that raises two interlocking blue energy walls around his castled position like a moat.

name: Sovereign Dome
description: If your King occupies one of the 4 central squares (d4, d5, e4, e5), grant all allied pieces currently adjacent (orthogonally or diagonally) to your King a kinetic shield until the start of your next turn (they cannot be captured by non-King enemy pieces).
card_description: If your King occupies one of the 4 central squares (d4, d5, e4, e5), grant all allied pieces currently adjacent (orthogonally or diagonally) to your King a kinetic shield until the start of your next turn (they cannot be captured by non-King enemy pieces).
image_description: A white King standing in the center of the board projecting a wide golden hemisphere of light that shields the allied Pawns and Knight standing around him.

name: Palace Curtain
description: If your King is on your 1st rank, place an impassable holographic wall for 2 turns on 1 empty 2nd-rank square adjacent to your King.
card_description: If your King is on your 1st rank, place an impassable holographic wall for 2 turns on 1 empty 2nd-rank square adjacent to your King.
image_description: A white King on the home rank raising his signet ring to conjure a tall, ornate golden forcefield wall on the open 2nd-rank tile in front of him.

name: Flank Redoubt
description: If your King is on the outer edge of the board (a-file, h-file, 1st rank, or 8th rank), your King may step 1 square onto an empty unthreatened square and leave an impassable holographic wall for 2 turns on the square he just vacated.
card_description: If your King is on the outer edge of the board (a-file, h-file, 1st rank, or 8th rank), your King may step 1 square onto an empty unthreatened square and leave an impassable holographic wall for 2 turns on the square he just vacated.
image_description: A white King stepping inward from the edge of the chessboard while a heavy stone-and-light barrier slams down onto the rim square he just left.

name: Forward Bastion
description: If your King is in enemy territory (ranks 5 through 8), place an impassable holographic wall for 2 turns on 1 empty square adjacent to your King and grant 1 adjacent allied non-King piece a kinetic shield until your next turn.
card_description: If your King is in enemy territory (ranks 5 through 8), place an impassable holographic wall for 2 turns on 1 empty square adjacent to your King and grant 1 adjacent allied non-King piece a kinetic shield until your next turn.
image_description: A white King leading the charge on the 5th rank, planting a glowing barrier wall ahead of him while wrapping his adjacent Knight in a golden protective aura.

name: Bodyguard Switch
description: If an allied non-King piece is orthogonally adjacent to your King, your King and that ally may swap positions (if swapping with an allied Pawn, both squares must lie between the 2nd and 7th ranks, and the King's new square must not be attacked by an enemy piece).
card_description: If an allied non-King piece is orthogonally adjacent to your King, your King and that ally may swap positions (if swapping with an allied Pawn, both squares must lie between the 2nd and 7th ranks, and the King's new square must not be attacked by an enemy piece).
image_description: A white King and an adjacent armored Rook trading places across a glowing golden circle on the floor to put the Rook between the King and danger.

name: Flank Escort
description: If an allied Pawn or minor piece is diagonally adjacent to your King, both your King and that ally may step 1 square in the exact same orthogonal direction onto empty squares (the King's destination must not be attacked, and standard 8th-rank Pawn promotion applies).
card_description: If an allied Pawn or minor piece is diagonally adjacent to your King, both your King and that ally may step 1 square in the exact same orthogonal direction onto empty squares (the King's destination must not be attacked, and standard 8th-rank Pawn promotion applies).
image_description: A white King and a diagonally adjacent white Bishop stepping forward in synchronized formation along parallel golden arrows.

name: Queen's Recall
description: If your Queen is within 3 squares of your King along an unobstructed rank, file, or diagonal, slide your Queen along that line onto the empty square immediately adjacent to your King (provided this does not expose your King to check).
card_description: If your Queen is within 3 squares of your King along an unobstructed rank, file, or diagonal, slide your Queen along that line onto the empty square immediately adjacent to your King (provided this does not expose your King to check).
image_description: A white King raising a glowing royal beacon as the white Queen streaks back along a beam of golden light to land directly beside his throne.

name: Twin Escort
description: If at least 2 allied Pawns are adjacent (orthogonally or diagonally) to your King, advance 2 of those adjacent Pawns 1 square straight forward onto empty squares simultaneously (standard 8th-rank promotion and King-safety rules apply).
card_description: If at least 2 allied Pawns are adjacent (orthogonally or diagonally) to your King, advance 2 of those adjacent Pawns 1 square straight forward onto empty squares simultaneously (standard 8th-rank promotion and King-safety rules apply).
image_description: A white King gesturing forward with both hands as two loyal Pawns flanking him march one square ahead in unison with glowing shields.

name: Phalanx March
description: If your King stands directly behind a horizontal line of at least 2 orthogonally connected allied Pawns, advance the Pawn directly in front of your King 1 square straight forward onto an empty square and immediately step your King 1 square forward onto the square that Pawn just vacated (provided that square is not attacked).
card_description: If your King stands directly behind a horizontal line of at least 2 orthogonally connected allied Pawns, advance the Pawn directly in front of your King 1 square straight forward onto an empty square and immediately step your King 1 square forward onto the square that Pawn just vacated (provided that square is not attacked).
image_description: A wall of white Pawns marching forward in lockstep while the white King strides regally into the sheltered pocket directly behind their advancing shields.

name: Break the Pin
description: If an allied piece adjacent to your King is pinned to your King by an enemy Rook, Bishop, or Queen, your King may leap 2 squares orthogonally or diagonally away from the pin line onto an empty square that is not controlled by an enemy piece (freeing your ally from the pin).
card_description: If an allied piece adjacent to your King is pinned to your King by an enemy Rook, Bishop, or Queen, your King may leap 2 squares orthogonally or diagonally away from the pin line onto an empty square that is not controlled by an enemy piece (freeing your ally from the pin).
image_description: A white King seeing his adjacent Knight trapped in a red sniper laser, vaulting two tiles sideways out of the beam's line so the Knight can move freely.

name: Secret Passage
description: If your King has 2 or fewer legal moves and is not in check, he may leap 2 squares orthogonally or diagonally over an adjacent piece or wall onto an empty square that is not controlled by an enemy piece.
card_description: If your King has 2 or fewer legal moves and is not in check, he may leap 2 squares orthogonally or diagonally over an adjacent piece or wall onto an empty square that is not controlled by an enemy piece.
image_description: A hemmed-in white King ducking through a hidden glowing trapdoor in the marble floor and emerging two squares away behind a wall of pieces.

name: Sanctuary Hop
description: If at least 3 of the squares adjacent to your King are controlled by enemy pieces (and your King is not currently in check), your King may make a (2,1) Knight jump over any intervening pieces onto an empty square that is not controlled by an enemy piece.
card_description: If at least 3 of the squares adjacent to your King are controlled by enemy pieces (and your King is not currently in check), your King may make a (2,1) Knight jump over any intervening pieces onto an empty square that is not controlled by an enemy piece.
image_description: Red crosshairs closing in on the tiles around a white King as he leaps in a glowing golden L-shaped Knight arc over the trap onto a safe distant square.

name: Sidestep Trap
description: If an enemy piece adjacent to your King cannot be legally captured by your King because it is defended by another enemy piece, your King may leap 2 squares horizontally left or right along his current rank onto an empty unthreatened square (jumping over whatever is on the intervening square).
card_description: If an enemy piece adjacent to your King cannot be legally captured by your King because it is defended by another enemy piece, your King may leap 2 squares horizontally left or right along his current rank onto an empty unthreatened square (jumping over whatever is on the intervening square).
image_description: A white King spotting an enemy Bishop waiting in ambush behind a bait Pawn, hopping two squares sideways along his rank over a friendly piece to safety.

name: Step Over Guard
description: If at least 3 squares adjacent to your King are occupied by allied pieces, your King may leap 2 squares straight orthogonally or diagonally directly over one of those adjacent allies onto the empty unthreatened square immediately on the other side of that ally.
card_description: If at least 3 squares adjacent to your King are occupied by allied pieces, your King may leap 2 squares straight orthogonally or diagonally directly over one of those adjacent allies onto the empty unthreatened square immediately on the other side of that ally.
image_description: A white King surrounded by his own crowded troops vaulting cleanly over the bowed head of an allied Pawn onto the open square in front of it.

name: Royal Judgement
description: If there are no Pawns of either color on your King's current file, your King may destroy 1 enemy Pawn or minor piece up to 2 squares straight ahead on that file (with no intervening pieces) without moving from his current square.
card_description: If there are no Pawns of either color on your King's current file, your King may destroy 1 enemy Pawn or minor piece up to 2 squares straight ahead on that file (with no intervening pieces) without moving from his current square.
image_description: A white King pointing his scepter down an open marble file, calling down a bolt of golden lightning onto an enemy Knight two squares ahead.

name: Scepter Sweep
description: If there are no other pieces on your King's current rank within 3 squares of him, your King may step 1 square along that rank onto an empty unthreatened square and simultaneously destroy 1 enemy Pawn orthogonally adjacent to his landing square.
card_description: If there are no other pieces on your King's current rank within 3 squares of him, your King may step 1 square along that rank onto an empty unthreatened square and simultaneously destroy 1 enemy Pawn orthogonally adjacent to his landing square.
image_description: A white King striding one tile sideways along a clear rank and swinging a glowing golden mace to shatter an enemy Pawn standing in front of his new square.

name: Signet Strike
description: If an unobstructed diagonal of at least 3 squares radiates from your King, your King may lunge 2 squares along that diagonal (over an empty intermediate square) to capture an undefended enemy Pawn or minor piece on an unthreatened square.
card_description: If an unobstructed diagonal of at least 3 squares radiates from your King, your King may lunge 2 squares along that diagonal (over an empty intermediate square) to capture an undefended enemy Pawn or minor piece on an unthreatened square.
image_description: A white King lunging two squares diagonally down an open lane with a blazing broadsword to cut down an isolated black Bishop.

name: Monarch's Decree
description: If your King and the enemy King stand on the same file or rank with no pieces between them (direct opposition), your King may destroy 1 enemy Pawn anywhere on that file, that rank, or an immediately adjacent file without moving from his current square.
card_description: If your King and the enemy King stand on the same file or rank with no pieces between them (direct opposition), your King may destroy 1 enemy Pawn anywhere on that file, that rank, or an immediately adjacent file without moving from his current square.
image_description: Two rival Kings staring each other down across an empty file in tense endgame opposition as the white King raises his hand to shatter a black Pawn on the neighboring file.

name: Execution Writ
description: If your King shares the same file, rank, or diagonal with the enemy King (even with pieces between them), your King may lunge 2 squares orthogonally (with an empty square in between) to capture an undefended enemy Pawn or minor piece on an unthreatened square.
card_description: If your King shares the same file, rank, or diagonal with the enemy King (even with pieces between them), your King may lunge 2 squares orthogonally (with an empty square in between) to capture an undefended enemy Pawn or minor piece on an unthreatened square.
image_description: A white King aligned with the distant black King charging two tiles straight ahead down the file to strike down an undefended black Knight.

name: Royal Stride
description: If your King is on his starting square (e1 for White; e8 for Black) and is not in check, he may move 2 unobstructed empty squares orthogonally or diagonally in any direction onto a square that is not controlled by an enemy piece.
card_description: If your King is on his starting square (e1 for White; e8 for Black) and is not in check, he may move 2 unobstructed empty squares orthogonally or diagonally in any direction onto a square that is not controlled by an enemy piece.
image_description: A white King rising from his starting e1 throne and striding two full tiles forward up an open central stairway of golden light.

name: Endgame March
description: If your King moved on your previous turn, he may move 2 unobstructed empty squares orthogonally (forward, backward, left, or right) this turn, provided neither the intermediate square nor the destination square is controlled by an enemy piece.
card_description: If your King moved on your previous turn, he may move 2 unobstructed empty squares orthogonally (forward, backward, left, or right) this turn, provided neither the intermediate square nor the destination square is controlled by an enemy piece.
image_description: An active white King marching briskly across an endgame board, covering two orthogonal squares in a single determined stride of golden light.

name: Knight's Crown
description: If your King has not moved for 3 or more consecutive turns and is not in check, he may make a (2,1) Knight jump onto an empty square that is not controlled by an enemy piece.
card_description: If your King has not moved for 3 or more consecutive turns and is not in check, he may make a (2,1) Knight jump onto an empty square that is not controlled by an enemy piece.
image_description: A long-still white King erupting with a spectral horse's crest around his crown, leaping in an L-shaped arc over his own pawns onto an open square.

name: Conquest Stride
description: If your King personally captured an enemy piece on your previous turn, he may take 2 consecutive 1-square King steps this turn onto empty squares (neither the intermediate square nor the final landing square may be controlled by an enemy piece, and he cannot return to his starting square).
card_description: If your King personally captured an enemy piece on your previous turn, he may take 2 consecutive 1-square King steps this turn onto empty squares (neither the intermediate square nor the final landing square may be controlled by an enemy piece, and he cannot return to his starting square).
image_description: A battle-crowned white King stepping away from a shattered enemy piece, taking two rapid, zig-zagging steps across glowing golden tiles to claim the center.

name: Diagonal Glide
description: If your King has moved on each of your last 2 turns, he may slide 2 unobstructed empty squares diagonally in any direction, provided neither the intermediate square nor the destination square is controlled by an enemy piece.

image_description: A white King in full momentum gliding two squares diagonally across the dark tiles on a trail of royal golden energy.
